race.comment: OPEN FIRE (14) has the most reliable recent profile, with consecutive fourths at Ballarat and Wangaratta and genuine excuses last time when slow away and steadied before finishing just over a length from Red Light Rachel. The Damian Lane booking strengthens the case and she looks the runner to beat. LEVENT (9) is the clear danger after finishing only a length and a half from Top Rich at Mornington, with that metro line reading well for this maiden. CHIQUITIPAPA (3) is the unknown but has trialled four times and his close second at Cranbourne gives him enough foundation to be treated seriously on debut. ZEFFIRELLI (8) has poor race form to overcome from last campaign but looks to be going well at the trials and can improve. PIERROBID (6) is going okay and in the mix.
